_comment: Schools currently outside the AP poll that could make it, or upset a ranked team. Names must match the poll/ratings names after team_name_standardization (e.g. 'Michigan State', not 'Michigan St.'). filter_schedule.py adds their games to the schedule, and prep_dashboard_data.py adds them to polls_games_dashboard.csv with school_type 'Watchlist' (becoming 'Ranked' if they enter the poll, 'Previously Ranked' if they drop out). Add or remove names here; nothing else needs editing.
